artifact_observations.reasoning: The musical notation on the sheets is illegible and structurally nonsensical (blobs instead of notes/staves), typical of AI generation failing to render complex symbolic text.
The alignment of the stop tabs on the right side appears slightly warped and inconsistent in spacing compared to the rigid geometry expected in real organ construction.
The wood texture on the console sides appears slightly smudged and lacks the sharp, linear grain detail typical of high-quality woodworking, suggesting minor generative smoothing.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific classification of the instrument and distinguish it from other keyboard instruments like harpsichords.
To rigorously analyze the illegibility of the musical notation and check for any hidden text artifacts.
To verify the spatial relationship between the console and the pipe facade, ensuring no melting or depth bleeding occurs.
To check for fused keys or stop tabs, which are common failure points in AI-generated mechanical objects.

focus_areas: Legibility and structure of musical notation on the stand
Geometric regularity and alignment of stop tabs/knobs
Boundary separation between individual piano/organ keys

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the sheet music; AI often fails to render valid musical staves and notes, resulting in 'gibberish' textures. Also, inspect the stop tabs for uniform spacing and alignment, as AI tends to warp repetitive geometric patterns. Verify that the keys on the manuals are distinct and not fused together.
